release_notes_summary: Stable 0.9.9 removes the visible Working notes editor while preserving saved-case notes.
notes: Removes the visible Working notes editor from the main window to recover vertical space. Existing saved-case notes continue to load and save.
Updates the welcome sentence to describe the case details that remain available.
Calculator results, formulas, case-file schema, and updater behavior are unchanged.
The public package retains the 0.9.8 reference allowlist and exact approved reference bytes; internal-only reference materials remain excluded.
Existing method limitations remain visible, including the off-axis method marked "Experimental - physical validation pending; not qualified for casework use."
Only stable version/channel/build metadata and stable updater-feed configuration differ from the tested source snapshot.
The 18 focused case-notes round-trip and layout tests, plus the tested local packaged startup smoke, passed before this metadata-only stable rebuild. No full suite was rerun.
Compiled app modules match the tested candidate except build metadata. The filtered public package contains 205 files.
